title: 第7章 想受罚咋就那么难呢第8章 照顾同乡
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 火焰疯狂将整个药王宫都烧成了灰烬。
无数看到火焰冲天的人从各个山头赶来灵鹤宫，但是所有赶到的人都懵了，因为这会儿灵鹤宫之中的大长老下了死命令，任何人绝对不准救火。
当听到这消息的时候，赶来帮忙的人都傻了。
灵鹤宫这是闹什么幺蛾子呢？
你们药王宫都没了……这还不救火？
你们整个灵鹤宫的人都喝多了么？
然后大家发现灵鹤宫的每一个人身上都散发着浓浓的酒气，好家伙，真的喝多了？
但很快，随着赶来帮忙的各个山头的长老来到药王宫这边，他们才真的明白发生了什么。
一只巨大的朱雀笼罩整个药王宫，而在无尽火海之中，一个浑身被赤金色火焰包裹的人凭空悬浮，朱雀不断的围绕着这个人上下飞舞！
朱雀通灵！
赶来的人明白为什么大长老不让救火了，这烧的是火吗？
这明明是朱雀通灵带来的火焰啊！
昊天宗四百年前药圣的传承，今天竟然真的出现了，这把将药王宫烧成灰烬的大火就是来自于药圣传承的朱雀通灵。
好家伙，这会儿大家终于明白为什么刚才看到大长老的时候非但没有在大长老脸上看到任何的愤怒悲伤，反而是带着狂喜。
起初大家以为大长老是气极反笑，但现在大家知道了……他气极个锤子……他是真的开心啊。
烧了一座药王宫，可是却拿到了药圣的传承，这别说是药王宫了，就是把整个灵鹤宫都烧了，大长老也一万个愿意吧。
熊熊烈火依旧在燃烧，而朱雀的传承也终于在火焰之中完成，最终那朱雀化为一道流光全部钻入了楚星河的眉心之中，楚星河身后火焰暴涨，赤金色火焰在他身后化为一道朱雀虚影。
朱雀展翅翱翔仿佛为楚星河插上了一双火焰翅膀。
而楚星河也从传承之中醒来，脑子里都是各种炼药的知识……都快成一锅粥了。
但这传承却带给了楚星河难以想象的好处……
月见草的纹路是这样的……月冥草的纹理是这样的……月魂草的微光是这样的……之前所有楚星河玩了命去记的东西现在只要楚星河想，脑子里面一搜全都一清二楚。
楚星河这会儿也意识到发生了什么，可问题是这特么不是自己想要的啊……我真不想做一个炼药师啊……我想成为武帝……真不行武宗也能先凑合啊……
大长老待到确定传承已经百分百完成了，他整个人不顾朱雀火焰的灼烧，亲自冲入了大火之中，一把抱住了一脸懵逼的楚星河，然后用一种极为羞耻的公主抱的形式将楚星河从大火之中抱出来。
大长老被朱雀火焰烧的头发胡子都黢黑一片，但这会儿他却笑的呲着一口小白牙。
“天佑昊天！”
这一刻无论是灵鹤宫的人，还是从外面赶来的人，看着大长老从火焰之中带出来的楚星河，全都开口高呼。
又是天佑昊天……楚星河听着这四个字都要吐血了……这老天只佑昊天，啥时候也佑我一下啊，我就想受罚怎么就那么难呢！
有人找来了衣服为楚星河披上，刚才的火焰早就把他身上所有的东西烧成灰烬，被抱出来的楚星河刚才可是一丝不挂的。
而刚刚披上衣服，楚星河就哭丧着脸开口了：“大长老……弟子……一个不小心把……把朱雀神炉弄炸了……点燃了整个药王宫……弟子有罪！”
楚星河这会儿也顾不得那么多了，不管咋说，咱最后努力一下争取个处罚是吧。
可是楚星河这话出口，大长老却哈哈大笑起来：“好孩子……好孩子啊……今日乃是朱雀通灵，又怎能怪你，况且朱雀神炉乃是神器，又岂会那么容易损坏，你看！”
content_en:
The flames burned the entire Yaowang Palace to ashes.
Countless people who saw the flames soaring into the sky rushed to Linghe Palace from various hills, but all those who arrived were stunned, because at this moment, the great elder in Linghe Palace issued a death order, and no one was allowed to put out the fire.
When they heard the news, the people who came to help were stunned.
What's going on in Linghe Palace?
Your Yaowang Palace is gone... Why don't you put out the fire?
Are all of you in Linghe Palace drunk?
Then everyone found that everyone in Linghe Palace smelled strongly of alcohol. Good guy, have you really drunk too much?
But soon, as the elders from various hills who came to help came to Yaowang Palace, they really understood what happened.
A huge Suzaku enveloped the entire Yaowang Palace, and in the endless sea of ​​fire, a person wrapped in red-gold flames floated out of thin air. The Suzaku kept flying up and down around this person!
Suzaku is psychic!
The people who arrived understood why the great elder refused to put out the fire. Is this a fire?
This is obviously the flame brought by Suzaku's channeling!
The inheritance of the Medicine Saint from the Haotian Sect four hundred years ago actually appeared today. The fire that burned the Medicine King's Palace to ashes was the Suzaku channel that came from the Medicine Saint's inheritance.
Good guy, now everyone finally understands why when they saw the great elder just now, instead of seeing any anger or sadness on the great elder's face, he was filled with ecstasy.
At first, everyone thought that the great elder was laughing out of anger, but now everyone knows... he is extremely angry... and he is really happy.
He burned down a Medicine King's Palace, but got the Medicine Saint's inheritance. Let alone the Medicine King's Palace, even if he burned down the entire Linghe Palace, the Great Elder would probably be willing to do so.
The raging fire was still burning, and the Suzaku inheritance was finally completed in the flames. In the end, the Suzaku turned into a stream of light and penetrated into Chu Xinghe's eyebrows. The flames behind Chu Xinghe surged, and the red-gold flame turned into a Suzaku shadow behind him.
The Suzaku spread its wings and soared as if it had given Chu Xinghe a pair of wings of flame.
And Chu Xinghe also woke up from the inheritance, and his mind was filled with all kinds of knowledge about refining medicine... It was almost like a pot of porridge.
But this inheritance has brought Chu Xinghe unimaginable benefits...
The texture of the evening primrose is like this... The texture of the moon grass is like this... The shimmer of the moon soul grass is like this... All the things that Chu Xinghe risked his life to remember before are now clear to Chu Xinghe as long as he thinks about it.
Chu Xinghe also realized what happened at this moment, but the problem is that this is not what he wants... I really don't want to be an alchemist... I want to be the Martial Emperor... If it doesn't work out, the Martial Sect can just make do with it first...
When the Great Elder was sure that the inheritance was 100% complete, he rushed into the fire himself regardless of the burning of the Suzaku flames, hugged the confused Chu Xinghe, and then carried Chu Xinghe out of the fire in a very shameful princess hug.
The great elder's hair and beard were all blackened by the flames of the Suzaku, but now he was smiling with his small white teeth.
"God bless Haotian!"
At this moment, both the people from Linghe Palace and those who came from outside started shouting when they saw Chu Xinghe brought out by the great elder from the flames.
God bless Haotian again... Chu Xinghe almost vomited blood when he heard these four words... God only bless Haotian, why should he bless me when he wants to? I just want to be punished, why is it so difficult!
Someone found clothes and put them on Chu Xinghe. The flames had already burned everything on him to ashes. Chu Xinghe was naked just now when he was carried out.
As soon as he put on his clothes, Chu Xinghe said with a mournful face: "The great elder...disciple...accidentally...exploded the Suzaku Divine Furnace...ignited the entire Medicine King Palace...disciple is guilty!"
Chu Xinghe couldn't care less at the moment. No matter what, let's try our best to get a punishment, right?
But when Chu Xinghe said these words, the elder laughed loudly: "Good boy... Good boy... Today is the Suzaku channel, so how can I blame you? Besides, the Suzaku Divine Furnace is a divine weapon, how can it be damaged so easily? Look!"
title_en: Chapter 7 Why is it so difficult to be punished? Chapter 8 Taking care of fellow villagers
